kpis.nom_fr: Croissance des commandes sur deux ans
kpis.citation: If you look at it on a two-year stack, over 7% order growth.

kpis.nom_fr: Taux de securisation du chiffre d affaires equipements
kpis.citation: Our secured rate on equipment, we're at over 80%, nearly 85% secured entering the quarter, which is up several percentage points versus prior quarters.

kpis.nom_fr: Expansion de marge attendue S2 vs S1
kpis.nom_source: basis points of expansion from the first half to the second half
kpis.citation: Now, interestingly, we'll do a little bit better than that this year, what it's going to come down to is really all the price and cost actions that we implemented in the second quarter that will carry us through into the second half, driving us over 300 basis points of expansion from the first half to the second half, with the other notable point being the new products that are coming in that are higher margins really help the mix as we approach the second half.

kpis.nom_fr: Impact de l inflation sur la marge
kpis.citation: In the second quarter, inflation was about 120 basis points headwind, which was in line with our expectations.
The $250 million assumption, which included some cushion in it when we put it together, is still the appropriate amount for where we sit today.
Despite very high inflation in the quarter, some of the highest that we've seen in years in a specific quarter, we still expanded margin excluding PCS by, I think, around 100 basis points.

kpis.nom_fr: Part des nouveaux produits dans la valeur des commandes
kpis.citation: We've had some growth here from some of the new products, but again, in the spectrum of all the products that we've talked about, it's still under 20% of the value, meaning it's still a smaller contributor.
